description: Accessibility statement of one site, built on the EU model statement, in fi, sv and en. action get (default; the fields, whether the hosted page is published and its address), html (locale fi/sv/en; the statement as HTML to paste into the site), save (fields: any of organizationName, websiteName, status full/partial/none as the owner states it, standard wcag21aa/wcag22aa, nonAccessible, disproportionateBurden, outOfScope, method self/third_party, manualChecks, preparedOn, reviewedOn, contactEmail, contactPhone, contactUrl, enforcement, locales; confirm), publish (on true/false; the hosted page; confirm). The statement always says which parts automated checks covered and that they cover only part of the requirements.

action.description: get is default. save and publish need confirm.

on.description: publish: true publishes the hosted page, false takes it down.

site.description: Accessiboss site: id, public key or domain. Optional when the account has one site.

name: oma_accessiboss_statement
title: Accessiboss accessibility statement
